task_completion.description: Log into the SEB Server as super-admin
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the SEB Server dashboard or administration panel after the agent enters 'super-admin' and 'admin'.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the Institutions management section
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a list of institutions or an 'Institutions' menu item selected in the sidebar/navigation.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct name and URL suffix in the creation form
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see 'Pacific Northwest Health Sciences Testing Center' in the Name field and 'pnhstc' in the URL suffix field.

task_completion.description: Set the institution status to active
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a checkbox or toggle for 'Active' or 'Enabled' being checked/selected during or after creation.

task_completion.description: Confirm the new institution appears in the list and is active
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a table row containing 'Pacific Northwest Health Sciences Testing Center', the suffix 'pnhstc', and a status indicator showing it is 'Active' or 'Enabled'.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than terminal commands to create the institution
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the mouse cursor interacting with form fields and buttons in the browser, not commands like 'curl' or 'sql' in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the UI rather than jumping directly to a success page
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the sequence of clicks from the login page to the institution creation form.

integrity.description: The agent typed or pasted the specific values into the browser fields
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the text 'Pacific Northwest Health Sciences Testing Center' appearing within the SEB Server's HTML input fields.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The institution name must be exactly 'Pacific Northwest Health Sciences Testing Center'. The URL suffix must be 'pnhstc'. The institution must be explicitly marked as 'Active' (usually a checkbox or status toggle in the SEB Server UI). Credentials for login are username 'super-admin' and password 'admin'.
